description.value:
As a bonus action, you lash a beam of ion energy at a creature within range, forming a sustained connection between you and it; make a ranged tech attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 ion damage immediately, and on each later turn you may spend a bonus action to deal another 1d8 ion damage automatically, so long as you don't use that bonus action for anything else. The power ends if the target leaves range or gains total cover from you.

Overcharge Tech. Casting with a slot of 2nd level or higher increases the initial damage by 1d8 for each slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
